sql: WITH a AS(SELECT r.year,r.round,re.* FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959), b AS(SELECT year,driver_id,MIN(round) f,MAX(round) l FROM a GROUP BY year,driver_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round)>=2) SELECT b.driver_id,b.year,b.f,b.l,COUNT(*) pairs,COUNT(DISTINCT x.result_id) first_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT y.result_id) last_rows FROM b JOIN a x ON x.year=b.year AND x.driver_id=b.driver_id AND x.round=b.f JOIN a y ON y.year=b.year AND y.driver_id=b.driver_id AND y.round=b.l AND y.constructor_id=x.constructor_id GROUP BY b.driver_id,b.year HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY b.driver_id,b.year
